natural_errors_note.explanation: Natural error recall=1.0 / fpr=0.0 for all three detectors is CORRECT for this synthetic workload. The ground-truth workload generates well-formatted PII (PERSON entities via Presidio's en_core_web_lg model, emails, phone numbers) that Presidio reliably detects. This is a known limitation of synthetic evaluation: real-world prompts may contain abbreviations, OCR noise, domain jargon, or novel entity formats that Presidio's regex/NER models miss. The controlled FNR/FPR sweeps (5 points each: 0%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%) are the rigorous experiment — they model the effect of any given error rate on cache security and utility, regardless of the specific detector used.

NON_SENSITIVE.note: No PII present; Presidio correctly returns LOW. fpr=0 expected.

CONTACT.note: Well-formatted contact PII; Presidio recall ~0.95+ in real deployments.

MEDICAL.note: Medical conditions (hypothyroidism, arthritis) are NOT a Presidio entity type. Presidio detects PERSON (patient name) but NOT the condition. Policy still correctly RESTRICTS due to PERSON → risk=MEDIUM. Real-world limitation: if patient name is absent or uses initials only, Presidio misses entirely (FN). This is the PRIMARY unsupported category.

FINANCIAL.note: Credit card, IBAN and bank numbers are well-supported; Presidio recall ~0.85-0.95.

ENTERPRISE_CONFIDENTIAL.note: Project/product code names (TITAN, AURORA) are NOT PII entities in Presidio. Only the PERSON associated with the project is detected. If no PERSON is mentioned, confidential enterprise info is missed entirely. Second unsupported category.

natural_errors_note.recommendation: For paper: (1) report per-category support status in Table 2; (2) use FNR sweep curves as the primary security evaluation; (3) note MEDICAL and ENTERPRISE_CONFIDENTIAL as unsupported/partial categories where real-world Presidio FNR may be 15-40%.
